entries.meaningZh: 小人国（《格列佛游记》中的虚构国度）
entries.en: The illustrator painted Lilliput in tiny patches of red and green.
entries.zh: 插画师用一小块一小块的红色和绿色画出了小人国。

entries.meaningZh: 必胜信念（本例含自以为优越的盲目自信）
entries.en: Their triumphalism left no room for doubt: they believed their cause could not possibly fail.
entries.zh: 他们那种自负的必胜信念容不下任何怀疑：他们认定自己的事业绝不可能失败。

entries.meaningZh: 贝尼（玻利维亚地名）
entries.en: Their letters from Beni were full of drawings and almost no news.
entries.zh: 他们从贝尼寄来的信里满是画，几乎没有什么消息。

entries.meaningZh: 里诺（美国城市）
entries.en: By the time we reached Reno, the last sandwich had disappeared from the picnic bag.
entries.zh: 我们到达里诺时，野餐包里最后一份三明治早已不见了。

entries.meaningZh: 罗马天主教（带贬损、冒犯意味的旧称）
entries.en: The preacher's repeated attacks on 'popery' showed his contempt for Roman Catholics.
entries.zh: 那位布道者反复攻击他所蔑称的“罗马天主教”，显露出对罗马天主教徒的鄙视。

entries.meaningZh: 从天文学角度
entries.en: The historian checked the proposed date astronomically, using the eclipse mentioned in the diary.
entries.zh: 历史学家利用日记中提到的日食，从天文学角度核对了所提出的日期。

entries.meaningZh: 使者的派遣（正式、较少见用法）
entries.en: The treaty provided for the annual legation of an envoy to the neighbouring court.
entries.zh: 条约规定每年向邻国朝廷派遣一名使者。

entries.meaningZh: 绿皮苹果
entries.en: She sliced a greening into the bowl and rubbed the juice from her thumb.
entries.zh: 她把一个绿皮苹果切进碗里，擦去拇指上的果汁。

entries.meaningZh: 白人社会（此处为贬指白人群体的侮辱语）
entries.en: The leaflet blamed 'whitey' for every setback, a claim the speaker challenged.
entries.zh: 那张传单把每次挫折都归咎于“白人社会”，这一说法受到了演讲者的质疑。

entries.meaningZh: 马那瓜
entries.en: His spare glasses were still in Managua, tucked inside the glasses case he had left behind.
entries.zh: 他的备用眼镜还在马那瓜，收在他遗留的那个眼镜盒里。

entries.meaningZh: 威尼斯（意大利语名称Venezia）
entries.en: They reached Venezia after dark, carrying the broken violin case between them.
entries.zh: 他们合力提着那个破损的小提琴盒，天黑后抵达了威尼斯。

entries.meaningZh: 戈兰高地（地区名，与Heights连用）
entries.en: The traveller kept a sketch of the Golan Heights folded inside a journal.
entries.zh: 那名旅行者在一本日记里保存着一张折好的戈兰高地素描。

entries.meaningZh: 《跑吧！孩子》（电影名）
entries.en: After the school screening of Homerun, the class stayed to discuss the film.
entries.zh: 学校放映《跑吧！孩子》后，全班留下来讨论了这部电影。

entries.meaningZh: 勇气（英式口语，keep your pecker up意为别灰心、振作起来）
entries.en: 'Keep your pecker up,' she said when his latest application was rejected.
entries.zh: 他的又一份申请被拒时，她说：“别灰心，振作起来。”

entries.meaningZh: 凸面木杆（高尔夫球杆，较少见用法）
entries.en: He wiped the grass from the old bulger before returning it to the leather golf bag.
entries.zh: 他擦掉旧凸面木杆上沾的草，再把球杆放回皮制高尔夫球包。

entries.meaningZh: 浑蛋（极粗俗、带性侮辱色彩的骂人话）
entries.en: His shout of 'cocksucker' shocked the room, and he apologised at once.
entries.zh: 他那声“浑蛋”的大骂让满屋子的人都震惊了，他立即道了歉。

entries.meaningZh: 三星电子（此处作电子产品品牌名）
entries.en: The Samsung monitor showed the same blue line even after we changed the cable.
entries.zh: 即使换了电缆，那台三星显示器上仍显示着同一条蓝线。

entries.meaningZh: 《一炮两响》（电影Trenchcoat）
entries.en: They stayed up late watching Trenchcoat, then argued about which scene was funniest.
entries.zh: 他们熬夜看《一炮两响》，随后争论哪一场戏最有趣。

entries.meaningZh: 海森堡（德国物理学家）
entries.en: The folder contained three photographs of Heisenberg and a handwritten list of questions.
entries.zh: 文件夹里装着三张海森堡的照片和一张手写的问题清单。

entries.meaningZh: 库斯科
entries.en: She found the missing button in the coat she had worn in Cuzco.
entries.zh: 她在自己在库斯科穿过的那件外套里找到了丢失的纽扣。

entries.meaningZh: 凯撒的（非手术义，较少见用法）
entries.en: In the play, the senator refuses to submit to Cesarean rule.
entries.zh: 剧中，那名元老拒绝服从凯撒的统治。

entries.meaningZh: 白鬼子（针对白人的种族侮辱语，冒犯性强）
entries.en: He objected when a stranger called him a honky and asked the man to stop.
entries.zh: 陌生人叫他“白鬼子”时，他表示反对，并要求那人住口。

entries.meaningZh: 女用披巾（较少见服饰用法）
entries.en: She drew the woollen manta over her shoulders as the courtyard grew cold.
entries.zh: 院子里渐冷，她把羊毛披巾拉到肩上。

entries.meaningZh: 国民党（政党名称）
entries.en: The archivist placed the old Kuomintang leaflet in a protective sleeve.
entries.zh: 档案员把那张国民党的旧传单放进了保护套。

entries.meaningZh: 爱普生（公司名；此处作打印机品牌名）
entries.en: The Epson printer stood on a low cabinet beside a stack of blank cards.
entries.zh: 那台爱普生打印机放在一个矮柜上，旁边是一摞空白卡片。

entries.meaningZh: 启发者（此处指帮助人理解思想的人）
entries.en: They remembered their teacher as an illuminator who made difficult ideas clear.
entries.zh: 他们记忆中的老师是一位启发者，能让艰深的思想变得清晰易懂。

entries.meaningZh: 引起杂音的收音机（早期无线电用语）
entries.en: In the old story, a neighbour's blooper filled their evening broadcast with whistles.
entries.zh: 那篇旧故事里，邻居那台引起杂音的收音机使他们收听的晚间广播充满了啸声。
